title: Renewal risk triage
transcript:
Consultant: How do account managers decide who to call first at renewal?
Client: They do not, really. They open the account list and guess.
Consultant: What would help?
Client: We would like a renewal risk field on the account, with low, medium
and high, so account managers can triage the list every Monday.
Consultant: Those three values exactly?
Client: Low, medium, high. Nothing more complicated than that.

expected.note: Picklist on Account with three values the client names explicitly.
